description: Task-family equivalence test: SST-2 vs IMDB sentiment on DistilBERT. Tests whether Gradience's strict task-identity boundary is correct or too conservative for practically similar tasks within the same sentiment family.
campaign_question: Is exact task identity too strict for practically similar sentiment tasks?

adapters.notes: SST-2 binary sentiment. Standard q_lin+v_lin LoRA.
SST-2 binary sentiment. Same config as myselfmankar. Provides exact same-task pair.
IMDB binary sentiment. Same target modules as SST-2 adapters. Primary cross-dataset test partner.
IMDB binary sentiment. Q-only LoRA (single target module). Trained on 1k samples — may be weaker.

dropped_adapters.reason: modules_to_save incompatibility — all 8 modules targeted including classifier/pre_classifier causes PEFT loading error

exact_same_task.description: SST-2 x SST-2 — baseline for retained same-task pairs

same_family_cross_dataset.description: SST-2 x IMDB — the key test. Same sentiment family, different dataset.

same_dataset.description: IMDB x IMDB — secondary same-task reference

cross_task_control.description: Reuse Phase 2 cross-task control data (sentiment x emotion/ag_news) as anchor

data_note: Evidence bootstrap uses shuffled sampling (seed=42) to avoid label-sorted split artifacts. The IMDB test split is sorted by label (first 12500 negative, then 12500 positive).
selection_rationale: 4 adapters on distilbert-base-uncased: 2 SST-2 + 2 IMDB. Generates 6 pairs. 1 exact same-task (SST-2 x SST-2), 4 same-family cross-dataset (SST-2 x IMDB), 1 same-dataset (IMDB x IMDB). No Yelp/Amazon DistilBERT LoRA adapters available on Hub.
